displayName: OCI-AI-PD-014: AI — Output Manipulation via Few-Shot Poisoning
description:
Detects few-shot poisoning attacks that manipulate model outputs through malicious examples

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

conditions.value: ai — output manipulation via few-shot poisoning

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_ai_pd_014", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%output%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%manipulation%') AND "value" > 0
